hypothesis: Improve probability of technical code using frozen molecular embeddings and kernel fusion
evidence: V7 primary OOF MSE 17964365.74; diagnostic true-code oracle 4262335.07, versus physical-only oracle 16158423.05
expected_impact: highest potential; both false positives and false negatives contribute
overfit_risk: moderate at 320 labels; freeze encoders, bounded choices, nested selection
cost: two fixed pretrained encoders, already extracted without labels

hypothesis: Calibrate confidence and ensemble complementary errors inside training
evidence: High-similarity observed ratios are assigned >8000 when nearest training labels are coded 10000; code confidence may be miscalibrated
expected_impact: potentially substantial but must confirm on paired OOF
overfit_risk: moderate; calibration and ensemble fitting strictly cross-fitted

hypothesis: Test raw notation versus structure-invariant pooled SMILES embeddings
evidence: Raw SMILES have 320 distinct strings; canonical graphs only 312, with contexts absent at inference
expected_impact: may capture encoded-label acquisition effects; not evidence of biological mechanism
overfit_risk: moderate/high source-shift risk; paired parent and scaffold diagnostics

hypothesis: Change conditional physical regression only if classifier experiments fail
evidence: One measured-SI outlier contributes 22.2% SSE; true physical oracle gives much smaller improvement than true-code oracle
expected_impact: bounded benefit for most rows; outlier has no similar high-label neighbor
overfit_risk: high if tuning to one row

hypothesis: Preserve discarded salt/stereo information or enlarge fingerprints
evidence: Empirical floors are identical for full canonical graph, parent and tautomer parent; no evidence that standardization created observed conflicts. Prior 72-kernel search failed nested validation.
cost: not repeated without a new specific failure

hypothesis: Add more copies of the known 56/38 external bank
evidence: 38 is a subset of 56, all already in curated table; prior paired weight=.25 experiments worsened MSE
expected_impact: no demonstrated benefit; needs genuinely new matched structures
overfit_risk: source/context mismatch and extreme physical values
